_comment: Slugs are the company identifier in each ATS board URL. greenhouse: boards.greenhouse.io/<slug>. lever: jobs.lever.co/<slug>. ashby: jobs.ashbyhq.com/<slug>. Every slug here was verified to return that company's postings on 2026-09-03, except ashby's linear, confluent, and neon, verified 2026-09-23. neogov: governmentjobs.com/careers/<slug>, a public agency rather than a company, verified 2026-09-23: washington is the state (careers.wa.gov), cobwa the City of Bellingham, skagitwa Skagit County. climatebase entries are search queries, not slugs; each returns its top 100. wordpress entries are <site>/<post type>, with ?search=<term> to narrow a busy board; each returns its newest 20. joshswaterjobs.com is Josh's Water Jobs, waconservationaction.org Washington Conservation Action. hackernews, remoteok, himalayas, and apple are whole feeds; their values are ignored. apple is a whole feed too: every US posting Apple marks home-office eligible. Boards that 404 are skipped. Title filters are per user and arrive as arguments to fetch, not from this file.
_not_coverable: Own careers sites or ATSs without a public feed, checked 2026-09-03: Meta, Fly.io, Oxide, HashiCorp, Astral, Modular, Hugging Face, dbt Labs, Dagster, Snyk, Felt, CARTO, Hipcamp, REI, Patagonia, Tesla, Rivian, Trek, Specialized. Check by hand or add a fetcher.
